CREATE TABLE `players` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'player name',
  `score` decimal(10,2) unsigned zerofill DEFAULT NULL,
  `created` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `kind` enum('a','b','c') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'a',
  `flags` set('x','y') DEFAULT NULL,
  `total` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS (`id` * 2) VIRTUAL,
  `stored` int AS (id + 1) STORED,
  `geo` point NOT NULL /*!80003 SRID 4326 */,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `name` (`name`(10)),
  KEY `idx_score` (`score` DESC) USING BTREE COMMENT 'score idx',
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft` (`name`) WITH PARSER ngram,
  SPATIAL KEY `sp` (`geo`),
  KEY `fx` ((`id` + 1), (lower(`name`))),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_team` FOREIGN KEY (`team_id`, `x`) REFERENCES `teams` (`id`, `y`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `chk` CHECK ((`score` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci ROW_FORMAT=DYNAMIC COMMENT='players table'
